quest.title: Just Like a Snowball
quest.description: Help the children produce a snowball of the perfect size

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll come back later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You should know I'm a pro at making snowmen!

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Oh? You sure sound like a confident grownup. Give it a try, then! And if you can give us the perfect snowballs we're looking for, I've got a reward for you!

dialogues.speaker: Krylov
dialogues.text: Remember, the snowballs must all be. Exactly. The. Same. Size...

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Well, not exactly "exactly," Krylov...

talks.objective: Help Miroslava build the perfect snowball

dialogues.speaker: Anfissa
dialogues.text: Wow, that snowman is fire! I'm gonna call it... Hmm, I'm gonna call it the "Super Snow Monsta"! Let's go~~~~~

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: I like that name. It sounds impressive. And now our "Snowman Squad" is also finally complete.

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Thank you. This is for you. I'd ask you to join us, but unfortunately, you're a little too old to be a member of the Angry Bears.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course! Gotta strike the iron while it's hot!

talks.objective: Help Krylov build the perfect snowball

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure!

talks.objective: Help Anfissa build the perfect snowball

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll come back to this later...

talks.objective: Talk to the three Savage Bears

dialogues.speaker: Anfissa
dialogues.text: Heh heh... We'll be able to build a snowman soon. Isn't that so exciting, Boss???

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Simmer down over there, Anfissa. Making a snowman is serious business. We need every snowball to be the exact right size to make this perfect, and we have to coordinate our efforts completely if we want the best possible result.

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: But the Angry Bears definitely need more hands on deck to make this happen... At the very least, we need someone who can make us the perfect snowballs...

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: These are absolutely perfect snowballs... All they need is a decoration here and there now. I hereby name this snowman "Big Cheese." From now on, Big Cheese will be a key member of the Angry Bears!

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: But of course, we still have another two snowmen to build... Would you like to give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Krylov can decorate and name this second snowman... A personal touch or two is totally acceptable once the snowman is up to standard.

dialogues.speaker: Krylov
dialogues.text: Hmm... I know. I'm gonna call it "Krylov's Number Two."

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Um, not bad... Then the only one left would be Anfissa's. Please, if you could continue to help us, that'd be great.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to disturb you. I've to go now.

dialogues.speaker: Miroslava
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You were unable to roll a snowball of just the right size. The three Savage Bears reset the field...
